title: GM Contract Full Chain and Transaction Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: Contract_ProcessOffer (RVA 0x12bc4a0) consumes a 48-byte ContractOfferContext: player ID at +0x0 (resolved via 0x140f3f580), team ID at +0x2 (resolved via 0x140f40eb0), annual salaries at +0x8..0x1c, and contract/option flags at +0x20.
claims.falsification_note: A submitted offer enters PENDING state (0x100000); it does NOT immediately mean SIGNED. Player AI must accept before execution completes.

claims.statement: Contract_CancelOffer (RVA 0x12b3840) cancels a pending contract offer by clearing bit 21 and marking status with 0x1c0000 (WITHDRAWN).
claims.falsification_note: Once an offer is accepted by the player, it cannot be withdrawn via 0x12b3840.

claims.statement: Contract_ProcessOptions (RVA 0x12bf5a0) executes during Offseason Phase 0x16 (22 decimal) to decide Team Options and Player Options.
claims.falsification_note: Team options cannot be unilaterally executed during regular season gameplay.
